title: Business Development Executive (IT Field Sales)
description:
Job Description Business Development Executive Inteliconvo | Recruitment & Loyalty | Post-Demo Closing Role 
 About Shyena Tech Yarns Shyena Tech Yarns builds AI-powered products that help enterprises automate the parts of their business that still run on manual effort. Our portfolio spans Agentic AI, Data Engineering, and Legacy Application Modernization, alongside AI products including Inteliconvo's Recruitment and Loyalty solutions, VIGIL (agentic observability and governance), Agent Assist, and Voice Bot. We work with enterprise clients across healthcare, BFSI, CPG, and pharma, with active business across India, the USA, and the Middle East. Inteliconvo specifically adds an AI Voice layer on top of what clients already use; their ATS for Recruitment, their loyalty platform for channel engagement; so adoption never means ripping out existing systems. This is a growth-stage team, which means a Business Development Executive here gets real ownership of the deals they close; direct client relationships, a real say in how a deal gets structured, and visibility into the business beyond a quota on a dashboard. 
 Designation note: this role sits after the SDR/lead-generation function it takes over once a lead is qualified or the first demo is done, and owns the relationship in person through to close, across both product lines. Business Development Executive is the standard title for this in Indian B2B SaaS; Account Executive or “Field Sales Executive” are equally valid alternatives if that fits your existing title structure better — the job itself doesn't change with the label. Role Business Development Executive — Recruitment & Loyalty Experience 3 years in B2B sales, with in-person/field client meeting experience Stage Owned From completed demo through to signed close, across both products Reporting To Business Development Manager / Sales Leadership, Inteliconvo 
 About the Products Inteliconvo's Recruitment product adds an AI Voice layer on top of a client's existing ATS; handling first candidate conversations, structured screening, and first-level interviews; without requiring a system replacement. Inteliconvo's Loyalty product adds an AI Voice layer on top of a client's existing loyalty platform; re-engaging dormant channel partners, handling reminders and follow-ups, and supporting onboarding; without requiring a platform replacement. 
 Role Summary Once an SDR has booked and completed a first demo; whether the lead is a Recruitment prospect (CHRO, Head of TA, HR Director) or a Loyalty prospect (Marketing, Trade Marketing, Channel/Loyalty leader); this role takes over. The BDE owns the relationship in person from there across both product lines: understanding the client's actual process, running the deal through every stage, and closing it. 
 Key Responsibilities Own qualified leads handed off by the SDR team from the point a demo has been completed; not before; across both Recruitment and Loyalty opportunities. Schedule and conduct in-person meetings with the relevant buyer for each deal: CHROs/Heads of TA/HR Directors for Recruitment, or Marketing/Trade Marketing/Channel leaders for Loyalty. Run each deal through L2 requirement discussion, NDA, proposal, negotiation, and trial/POC, to signed close; owning every stage after the first demo. Understand each client's actual environment before proposing a configuration; their ATS and hiring process for Recruitment deals, their loyalty platform and partner base for Loyalty deals. No generic pitch in the room, for either product. Coordinate with the presales/solutions team to scope and deliver tailored demos or pilots based on what came up in the client meeting. Negotiate commercial terms and close the agreement, keeping deal value, probability, and expected close date current in the CRM at every stage, for both product lines. Travel within the assigned region for client visits, on-site demos, and relationship-building meetings as needed. 
 What We're Looking For 3 years of B2B sales experience, with genuine field/in-person client meeting exposure; not purely remote or inbound sales. Comfortable running a consultative, senior-stakeholder meeting solo, without a manager in the room. A track record of closing deals, not just generating or progressing pipeline. Strong follow-through on CRM hygiene; deal stage, next action, and close date updated after every meeting, not once a week. Comfortable switching context between two different buyer personas and two different product pitches within the same week. Willing and able to travel locally/regionally for client visits. 
 Good to Have Prior experience selling into HR/TA teams, an ATS, HRMS, or recruitment-adjacent product. Prior experience selling into Marketing, Trade Marketing, or Channel teams, or a loyalty/rewards/CRM platform. Experience carrying more than one product line or vertical at once in a previous sales role.

Key Skills: Sales,Lead Generation,Field Sales,Business Development,IT Sales,ERP / CRM / SaaS,Presales,B2B Sales

title: Cutting Tools Sales Manager
description:
Role & Responsibilities Drive sales of GESAC tungsten carbide cutting tools and indexable inserts across Maharashtra through dealers as well as direct end-user customers . Develop new business by identifying and approaching CNC machining companies, OEMs, auto-component manufacturers, engineering companies, job shops and industrial customers . Leverage existing relationships with dealers, distributors, purchase teams, production managers, tool room managers and CNC programmers to generate business. Understand the customer's machining process, material, machine, component, cutting conditions and application requirements . Select the appropriate insert grade, geometry, chip breaker and cutting parameters using GESAC catalogues, application data and technical support. Conduct and manage tool trials at customer sites and demonstrate the performance and cost benefits of GESAC inserts. Establish and prove CPC (Cost Per Component) / tool cost savings against competing brands and convert successful trials into regular business. Identify opportunities to replace competing brands and increase GESAC's share of the customer's total cutting-tool consumption. Develop and execute conversion strategies for specific applications, machines and components currently using competitor products. Manage the complete sales cycle lead generation technical discussion insert selection trial CPC validation commercial negotiation order closure repeat business . Regularly visit existing customers and dealers to understand their changing requirements and identify new applications and additional business opportunities . Monitor customer and dealer purchases, product movement and consumption to identify opportunities for increasing share of wallet . Develop and maintain strong relationships with dealers and ensure adequate stock availability, product movement and market coverage . Track enquiries, quotations, trials, orders and sales pipeline and provide regular reports to management. Ensure timely payment collection from customers and dealers and actively follow up on outstanding receivables. Collect market intelligence on competitor brands, pricing, grades, applications, new products and customer requirements . Coordinate with the GESAC technical team and management for complex applications, product recommendations and technical support. Achieve assigned sales, new customer acquisition, conversion and collection targets for Maharashtra. Preferred Candidate Profile 5–10 years of experience in the cutting tool / tungsten carbide tooling industry . Candidate must have worked with a cutting tool manufacturer, authorized distributor/dealer or established cutting-tool trading company . Strong practical knowledge of indexable carbide inserts, turning, milling, drilling and other CNC machining applications . Should understand cutting parameters such as cutting speed, feed, depth of cut, insert geometry, grade and chip breaker selection . Must be capable of understanding a customer's machining application and using catalogues/application data to select the appropriate insert . Experience in conducting tool trials and CPC/Cost Per Component comparisons is highly preferred. Should have a proven ability to convert customers from competing cutting-tool brands . Must have an existing network/relationships with CNC machining companies, OEMs, auto-component manufacturers, engineering companies, job shops and cutting-tool dealers in Maharashtra . Experience handling both direct end users and dealers/distributors will be an advantage. Strong business development, negotiation, follow-up and closing skills . Commercially aware and comfortable handling pricing, margins, sales targets and payment collections . Should be willing to travel extensively across Pune and Maharashtra for customer visits and trials. Mechanical Engineering Diploma/Degree or equivalent technical qualification preferred. Good communication skills in English, Hindi and Marathi . Should be self-driven, technically confident and capable of independently handling customers from initial enquiry through trial, conversion and repeat sales . Valid driving licence and willingness to travel within Maharashtra is required. Perks and Benefits Competitive salary based on experience and existing industry network . Performance-based incentives linked to sales and business development. Travel allowance / reimbursement for customer and dealer visits. Opportunity to work with GESAC, a leading global tungsten carbide cutting-tool manufacturer . Opportunity to build and manage the GESAC business across Maharashtra . Strong growth opportunity within a growing technical-sales organization. Exposure to a wide range of CNC machining applications, industries and cutting-tool technologies .

description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Job Title: Area Sales Manager Reports to:- Branch Manager Versuni, formerly known as Philips Domestic Appliances, has a simple yet powerful purpose of turning houses into homes. As a house of brands Versuni is home to the brands: Philips, Preethi, Saeco, Gaggia, Philips Walita, L'OR Barista and Senseo. Through meaningful innovation, we improve the lives of people, helping them to lead healthier and happier lives every day. We are looking for a highly motivated, progressive thinker who works with a growth mindset. If you love innovation, challenges and fast-paced ideation, this role may be for you. 
 You have the opportunity to: We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Area Sales Manager (ASM) to join our team. The ASM will be responsible for managing sales operations within a designated geographic area, driving sales growth, and building strong relationships with customers and distributors. Key responsibilities include: Implement sales strategies to achieve sales targets and expand market share within the assigned territory. Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats. Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, distributors, and retail partners. Address customer inquiries, resolve issues, and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction. Identify and develop new business opportunities in terms of distribution to increase sales and market presence. Coordinate with marketing and product teams to support promotional activities and product launches. Prepare accurate sales forecasts and develop sales plans to meet business objectives. Collaborate with supply chain and logistics teams to ensure product availability and timely delivery. To succeed in this role, you should have the following qualifications and experience: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field. MBA is a plus. 7-12 years of consumer durable/ small domestic appliances industry experience. Strong relationship with the distributors, retailer, customer. Proven track record of achieving sales targets and driving revenue growth. Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret sales data and market trends. Proficiency in MS Office and CRM software. Ability to travel within the assigned territory as required. What we offer: Paid time off:- Four weeks paid time off and ten public holidays each year. Paid Sick Leaves:- Unlimited sick leaves in case of employee being unfit for work due to personal illness or injury. Maternity Leaves:- All women employees at Versuni are entitled to fully paid Maternity leave of twenty-six weeks. Child adoption is treated as similar to childbirth at Versuni. Paternity leaves:- Versuni Paternity policy enables fathers (including father of a legally adopted child) to provide care to the child, develop an emotional bond and share responsibility with the mother. All male employees can avail a total of eight weeks’ of paid paternity leave till the child turns two. Higher education policy:- Covers expenses for higher education that will enhance employees’ performance in their current roles and facilitate career progression. MyBenefits@Versuni:- Flexible benefit program where employees can choose their insurance or non-insurance benefits Life Event:- Creche Reimbursement to support female employees in taking care of their young children Company car lease scheme:- The CCLS can be opted by the employee as part of the Flexible Benefits Package (FBP). This benefit is to provide car for personal and official use. It also provides for tax benefits under the current income tax laws. Product Discounts:- Exclusive employee discounts on Preethi and Philips brand products Why should you join Versuni? At Versuni, we design, manufacture, and sell market-leading products under the well-known brands like Philips, Saeco, Gaggia, Preethi, Philips Walita, L'OR Barista and Senseo. We do this with the simple yet powerful purpose of turning houses into homes. As a leading player in domestic appliances, we offer sustainable products across kitchen appliances, coffee, air, garment, and home care. For the past century, we've innovated to make products faster, better, and more energy efficient. Since 2020, our operations have been 100% carbon neutral, but this is just the beginning of our plan. We know everything we use today will affect the planet tomorrow. With ambitious goals set for 2025 and beyond, we are looking for forward-thinking individuals who are prepared to take their careers to new heights and drive innovation and growth within our global markets. If you’re ready to join a company that values your talent and offers opportunities for meaningful impact, Versuni is the place for you. Apply today and help us shape the future of home living!

 Joining: Immediate Joiners / Short Notice Preferred JOB SUMMARY We are looking for a confident, proactive, and target-oriented CRM & Sales BDM with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in Sales, Business Development, CRM, Client Relationship Management, and Sales Coordination. The ideal candidate should have fluent English communication skills, excellent client-handling ability, and hands-on experience in new client acquisition, lead generation, client meetings, sales coordination, follow-ups, and existing client management. The candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, arranging client meetings, maintaining strong relationships with existing clients, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth business operations and sales conversion. KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES 1. New Client Acquisition & Business Development Identify and research potential new clients and business opportunities. Generate new leads through market research, references, networking, online platforms, databases, and other sources. Contact prospective clients and understand their business requirements. Introduce company services professionally and generate business opportunities. Develop and maintain a strong sales pipeline. Follow up with prospects and convert qualified leads into business. 2. New Client Meetings Search for and identify potential clients for business development. Schedule and arrange new meetings with prospective clients. Attend client meetings and understand their requirements. Present company services and proposals professionally. Maintain regular follow-up after meetings and work towards business closure. Build relationships with key decision-makers. 3. Existing / Old Client Coordination Maintain regular communication and coordination with existing clients. Understand client requirements, feedback, and concerns. Ensure timely follow-up and resolution of client queries. Develop long-term relationships with existing clients. Identify opportunities for repeat business, upselling, and cross-selling. Maintain accurate and updated client information in the CRM. 4. Sales Coordination Coordinate with internal departments for client requirements and commitments. Follow up on quotations, proposals, contracts, orders, and documentation. Coordinate with Operations, Accounts, Administration, and other departments. Track sales activities, pending requirements, client commitments, and follow-ups. Ensure timely communication between clients and internal teams. 5. Client Communication Communicate with clients through telephone calls, emails, meetings, and professional correspondence. Demonstrate fluent English speaking and writing skills. Handle client queries professionally and provide timely responses. Maintain professional communication with senior-level clients and decision-makers. Build trust and maintain positive client relationships. 6. Lead Generation & Market Research Search and identify new companies, industries, and prospective customers. Identify relevant decision-makers and business contacts. Maintain and regularly update the prospect/client database. Research market trends, customer requirements, and potential business opportunities. Continuously develop new sources for lead generation. 7. CRM & Sales Reporting Maintain accurate and updated CRM records. Update lead status, client meetings, calls, follow-ups, proposals, and conversions. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports. Maintain sales pipeline and opportunity tracking. Provide regular business development updates to the Sales Head / Management. REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in Sales / Business Development / CRM / Client Relationship Management. Experience in new client acquisition and B2B sales. Excellent and fluent English communication skills. Strong client-handling and relationship-management skills. Experience in arranging and attending client meetings. Strong lead-generation, follow-up, negotiation, and conversion skills. Sales coordination and CRM management experience. Good knowledge of MS Office, Excel, and CRM software. Strong presentation and interpersonal skills. Confident, professional, proactive, and target-oriented personality. KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS (KPIs) New client acquisition. Qualified leads generated. New client meetings arranged. Sales pipeline development. Lead-to-business conversion. Existing client relationship and retention. Repeat business / upselling opportunities. Timely follow-up and closure. CRM data accuracy. Achievement of assigned sales targets. CANDIDATE PROFILE The ideal candidate should be a confident, well-presented, and professional female candidate with strong English communication, client handling, sales, business development, CRM, and coordination skills. The candidate should be comfortable with calling new clients, searching for new business opportunities, arranging client meetings, meeting clients personally, following up with prospects, coordinating with existing clients, and developing long-term business relationships. title: Business Resilience Manager
description:
As Business Resilience Manager within Ecolabs Global Business Solutions+ (GBS+) Enterprise AI organization, you will lead the execution of a critical capabilityensuring the continuity and resilience of essential global services. GBS+ is a multifunctional shared services platform supporting Finance, Supply Chain, Marketing, Legal, HR, Real Estate, and Automation across five global locations. In this role, you will own the development, testing, and continuous improvement of business continuity and resilience plans, enabling both GBS+ and AI operations to withstand and recover from disruptions. You will provide strategic oversight, expert guidance, and handson support to proactively manage risk, strengthen preparedness, and drive effective incident response. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Strategy Governance, you will partner closely with functional leaders to embed resilience into business planning, elevate organizational readiness, and ensure alignment with enterprise standards. This position is located at Ecolabs GBS Global Service Delivery Center in Pune, India (hybrid schedule, 60% time in the office, working the 12 pm-9 pm IST shift Mon-Fri) Whats in it For You: The opportunity to take on some of the worlds most meaningful challenges, helping customers achieve clean water, safe food, and healthy environments The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best Be part of an outstanding team with relentless focus on improvement through digital enhancements, process automation and AI opportunities What You Will Do: Partner with functional and site stakeholders to conduct risk assessments and business impact assessments, evaluating the impact of potential disruptions across GBS+ processes and global locations Define, prioritize, and lead risk mitigation initiatives aligned to business priorities and service criticality Own the development, maintenance, and maturation of sustainable Business Continuity Plans (BCPs) across GBS+ functions and locations to reduce business interruption risk Design and deliver BCP training, simulations, and exercises; analyze results to identify gaps, drive improvements, and reinforce a culture of preparedness Establish and govern a structured cadence for BCP testing, review, and updates to ensure plans remain current with organizational changes and site operations Maintain an inventory of AI-supported services and process dependencies; tier criticality and document potential failure modes Define continuity and recovery targets for AI-enabled capabilities (e.g., Recovery Time Objective where applicable) Design, document, and test fallback procedures when AI is unavailable, including manual workarounds, human review queues, and nonAI alternatives (rules-based logic, templates, and standard operating procedures) Plan and facilitate resilience exercises that include AI outage and degraded-quality scenarios; validate business readiness, recovery steps, and communications to internal stakeholders Support GBS+ leadership during real disruption events, coordinating response activities and ensuring effective execution of continuity plans Collaborate with digital, technology, and operations teams to strengthen the resilience of critical systems and services, including resilience plans for AI-supported services Monitor, analyze, and report resilience metricsincluding KPIs, incidents, and outagesto measure program effectiveness and support continuous improvement Minimum Qualifications: Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Risk Management, Emergency Management, or a related field Minimum of 12+ years of experience in business resilience, business continuity, risk management, or related disciplines, with a proven track record of program execution Solid understanding of business resilience principles and crisis management practices Knowledge of shared services operating models and the unique resilience considerations within a global services environment Familiarity with Fusion Risk Management preferred Demonstrated ability to lead crossfunctional initiatives and collaborate across geographies and cultures to influence stakeholders and deliver results Experience managing complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and interdependencies Proven experience designing and leading training programs, workshops, and business resilience exercises or drills Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and support leaders at multiple levels of the organization Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team Preferred Qualifications: Professional certification in Business Continuity or Risk Management Experience working in a large consulting firm (Accenture, McKinsey, EY, PWC, etc.)

title: Sales Ops Specialist
description:
JOB SUMMARY The sales team at Cohesity is on a mission to help organizations around the world find limitless value from their data. Our customer-obsessed Account Executives are focused on building new businesses while expanding the value of Cohesity for existing customers. As a Sr. Business Operations Analyst , you will play a pivotal role in ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and accessibility while driving impactful insights through advanced BI solutions. With a focus on implementing and maintaining robust data governance frameworks, you will ensure compliance, standardization, and integrity of organizational data. Reporting to the Sr. Manager Business Intelligence , you will be the key to empowering data-driven decision-making across the organization. We are a dedicated team of data enthusiasts who thrive on transforming complex information into actionable insights. With a strong focus on data integrity and governance, we aim to empower smarter decision-making across the organization. We are looking to expand our team with like-minded individuals who are passionate about driving data excellence, fostering innovation, and ensuring seamless access to trusted data for all stakeholders. HOW YOULL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE Develop and maintain a deep understanding of our organization's business processes and data needs. Design and develop data models, dashboards, and reports to support business needs. Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform business decisions. Develop and maintain documentation, including data definitions, business rules, and data lineage. Help establish and implement a robust data governance framework to ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align data processes with organizational goals. Identify and recommend improvements to data collection processes, systems, and tools. Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies in the field of data analytics & data governance. WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING Strong Analytical Skills – Ability to analyze complex datasets and derive actionable insights to support business decisions. Attention to Detail – Meticulous focus on accuracy and consistency in data and reporting processes. Technical Proficiency – Expertise in BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), SQL, Snowflake, and data governance platforms, along with an understanding of database structures. Problem-Solving Mindset – Proactive approach to identifying issues and implementing data-driven solutions. Effective Communication – Clear and concise communication skills to translate technical findings into business language for diverse stakeholders. Collaboration and Stakeholder Management – Ability to work cross-functionally, build relationships, and influence teams to adopt data governance practices. Adaptability and Learning Agility – Eagerness to stay updated on emerging trends in BI and data governance and quickly adapt to new tools and processes

description:
Technical Sales Executive Adhesives | Coatings | Thermal Materials 30,000 Fixed + Commission | 50,000+ Earning Potential Company: Amatech Innovation Pvt. Ltd. 
 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Travel across Gujarat & Maharashtra 
 Experience: 1–2 Years 
 Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / M.Sc. – Chemical, Polymer, Chemistry or related fields 
 Reports to: Founder Build Your Career in Technical Sales & Advanced Materials Want a career where your technical knowledge can directly translate into business and income? Amatech Innovation is looking for a driven, technically curious and coachable Technical Sales Executive to join our growing team. This is not a conventional sales job. You will work directly with the Founder, meet OEMs and industrial customers, understand their technical challenges, recommend material solutions, coordinate product trials and convert successful technical engagements into commercial business. If you are ambitious, comfortable with field work and want to develop expertise in specialty adhesives, thermal management materials and protective coatings, this is an opportunity to build a strong technical-sales career from the ground up. About Amatech Innovation Amatech Innovation Pvt. Ltd. is an Ahmedabad-based advanced materials technology company developing and manufacturing high-performance specialty materials for demanding industrial applications. Our key technology platforms include: Linkobond® – Specialty Adhesives Amasil® – Thermal Management Materials Amacoat® – Protective & Functional Coatings Custom-engineered material solutions Our products are used for applications across: EV & Batteries | Electronics | Electrical | Automotive | Pumps | LED | Industrial OEMs We are a lean, founder-driven company with strong technical and R&D capabilities, now expanding our technical sales and business development team. What You Will Do Your job is to understand the customer's problem, identify the right technical solution and turn the opportunity into business. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new OEM and industrial customers across Gujarat and Maharashtra. Prospect customers in EV/battery, electronics, electrical, automotive components, pumps, LED and industrial segments. Meet engineers, R&D teams, plant personnel, purchase teams and business owners. Understand customer applications, specifications, performance requirements and material challenges. Recommend suitable Amatech products or coordinate with the technical team for customized solutions. Conduct technical product presentations and customer discussions. Coordinate samples, trials, testing and technical follow-ups. Convert successful trials into commercial orders and repeat business. Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline. Maintain systematic records of customer visits, samples, trials, quotations and opportunities. Work with existing channel partners and support expansion of the distribution network. Achieve agreed activity, customer acquisition and revenue targets. Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to the Founder and R&D team. Who Are We Looking For? We are looking for someone who is technically curious, commercially driven and willing to learn. Preferred Profile Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / M.Sc. in Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Chemistry or related disciplines. 1–2 years of experience in technical sales, application engineering, application support or industrial sales. Experience with adhesives, coatings, sealants, potting compounds, thermal materials, industrial chemicals or electronics/electrical components will be an advantage. Freshers with strong technical fundamentals and genuine interest in technical sales are welcome. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Comfortable discussing technical subjects with engineers and customers. Willingness to travel extensively across Gujarat and Maharashtra. Good English and Hindi communication; Gujarati or Marathi will be an advantage. Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred. Attitude Matters More Than Experience We are particularly looking for someone who is: Driven • Coachable • Curious • Persistent • Customer-focused • Energetic • Comfortable with field work • Willing to learn If you want a desk-based 9-to-5 job, this role may not be for you. If you want to meet customers, learn technology, solve industrial problems, develop business and grow rapidly, we want to hear from you. Compensation & Earning Potential 30,000/month Fixed + Attractive Commission Your earning potential is linked to your performance. 30,000/month fixed salary Attractive commission on collected sales Performance-based incentives Quarterly bonuses Travel reimbursement Mobile allowance 50,000+ monthly earning potential for strong performers Performance-linked increase in fixed compensation Opportunity to take ownership of important customers, territories and accounts Performance = Growth At Amatech, we don't want salespeople who simply complete their daily activities. We want people who create customers and generate business. A strong performer who consistently develops customers and delivers collected sales can target 50,000+ monthly earnings, with significantly higher earning potential as the business grows. Your career progression will be based primarily on what you achieve — not simply how long you have been with the company. Why Join Amatech? Learn Advanced Materials Technology Gain practical exposure to specialty adhesives, thermal management materials, potting compounds, coatings and application engineering. Work Directly With the Founder Learn customer engagement, technical selling, negotiation and business development directly from company leadership. Work With Real Industrial Customers Interact with OEMs, engineers, R&D teams, plant heads and purchase teams rather than relying only on conventional distribution sales. Build Something From the Ground Up You will not simply inherit a territory. You will help build Amatech's technical sales function and customer base. High Performance = High Earning Potential Your income can grow significantly through commission and performance incentives. Fast Career Growth In a growing company, capable performers can take on responsibility much faster than in a traditional large organization. Build an Indian Advanced Materials Company Be part of a team developing and commercializing high-performance, India-origin materials for global industrial applications. Location & Travel Base: Ahmedabad, Gujarat The role involves regular travel across Gujarat and Maharashtra for customer development, technical meetings, product trials and business development. How to Apply Send your updated CV to: careers@amatech.co.in or info@amatech.co.in Subject: Technical Sales Executive – Amatech Please mention your current location, qualification, experience and notice period in your application. If you are ambitious, technically curious and ready to build your career in technical sales — we want to hear from you.

description:
Technical Sales Executive Adhesives | Coatings | Thermal Materials 30,000 Fixed + Commission | 50,000+ Earning Potential Company: Amatech Innovation Pvt. Ltd. 
 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Travel across Gujarat & Maharashtra 
 Experience: 1–2 Years 
 Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / M.Sc. – Chemical, Polymer, Chemistry or related fields 
 Reports to: Founder Build Your Career in Technical Sales & Advanced Materials Want a career where your technical knowledge can directly translate into business and income? Amatech Innovation is looking for a driven, technically curious and coachable Technical Sales Executive to join our growing team. This is not a conventional sales job. You will work directly with the Founder, meet OEMs and industrial customers, understand their technical challenges, recommend material solutions, coordinate product trials and convert successful technical engagements into commercial business. If you are ambitious, comfortable with field work and want to develop expertise in specialty adhesives, thermal management materials and protective coatings, this is an opportunity to build a strong technical-sales career from the ground up. About Amatech Innovation Amatech Innovation Pvt. Ltd. is an Ahmedabad-based advanced materials technology company developing and manufacturing high-performance specialty materials for demanding industrial applications. Our key technology platforms include: Linkobond® – Specialty Adhesives Amasil® – Thermal Management Materials Amacoat® – Protective & Functional Coatings Custom-engineered material solutions Our products are used for applications across: EV & Batteries | Electronics | Electrical | Automotive | Pumps | LED | Industrial OEMs We are a lean, founder-driven company with strong technical and R&D capabilities, now expanding our technical sales and business development team. What You Will Do Your job is to understand the customer's problem, identify the right technical solution and turn the opportunity into business. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new OEM and industrial customers across Gujarat and Maharashtra. Prospect customers in EV/battery, electronics, electrical, automotive components, pumps, LED and industrial segments. Meet engineers, R&D teams, plant personnel, purchase teams and business owners. Understand customer applications, specifications, performance requirements and material challenges. Recommend suitable Amatech products or coordinate with the technical team for customized solutions. Conduct technical product presentations and customer discussions. Coordinate samples, trials, testing and technical follow-ups. Convert successful trials into commercial orders and repeat business. Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline. Maintain systematic records of customer visits, samples, trials, quotations and opportunities. Work with existing channel partners and support expansion of the distribution network. Achieve agreed activity, customer acquisition and revenue targets. Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to the Founder and R&D team. Who Are We Looking For? We are looking for someone who is technically curious, commercially driven and willing to learn. Preferred Profile Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / M.Sc. in Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Chemistry or related disciplines. 1–2 years of experience in technical sales, application engineering, application support or industrial sales. Experience with adhesives, coatings, sealants, potting compounds, thermal materials, industrial chemicals or electronics/electrical components will be an advantage. Freshers with strong technical fundamentals and genuine interest in technical sales are welcome. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Comfortable discussing technical subjects with engineers and customers. Willingness to travel extensively across Gujarat and Maharashtra. Good English and Hindi communication; Gujarati or Marathi will be an advantage. Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred. Attitude Matters More Than Experience We are particularly looking for someone who is: Driven • Coachable • Curious • Persistent • Customer-focused • Energetic • Comfortable with field work • Willing to learn If you want a desk-based 9-to-5 job, this role may not be for you. If you want to meet customers, learn technology, solve industrial problems, develop business and grow rapidly, we want to hear from you. Compensation & Earning Potential 30,000/month Fixed + Attractive Commission Your earning potential is linked to your performance. 30,000/month fixed salary Attractive commission on collected sales Performance-based incentives Quarterly bonuses Travel reimbursement Mobile allowance 50,000+ monthly earning potential for strong performers Performance-linked increase in fixed compensation Opportunity to take ownership of important customers, territories and accounts Performance = Growth At Amatech, we don't want salespeople who simply complete their daily activities. We want people who create customers and generate business. A strong performer who consistently develops customers and delivers collected sales can target 50,000+ monthly earnings, with significantly higher earning potential as the business grows. Your career progression will be based primarily on what you achieve — not simply how long you have been with the company. Why Join Amatech? Learn Advanced Materials Technology Gain practical exposure to specialty adhesives, thermal management materials, potting compounds, coatings and application engineering. Work Directly With the Founder Learn customer engagement, technical selling, negotiation and business development directly from company leadership. Work With Real Industrial Customers Interact with OEMs, engineers, R&D teams, plant heads and purchase teams rather than relying only on conventional distribution sales. Build Something From the Ground Up You will not simply inherit a territory. You will help build Amatech's technical sales function and customer base. High Performance = High Earning Potential Your income can grow significantly through commission and performance incentives. Fast Career Growth In a growing company, capable performers can take on responsibility much faster than in a traditional large organization. Build an Indian Advanced Materials Company Be part of a team developing and commercializing high-performance, India-origin materials for global industrial applications. Location & Travel Base: Ahmedabad, Gujarat The role involves regular travel across Gujarat and Maharashtra for customer development, technical meetings, product trials and business development. How to Apply Send your updated CV to: careers@amatech.co.in or info@amatech.co.in Subject: Technical Sales Executive – Amatech Please mention your current location, qualification, experience and notice period in your application. If you are ambitious, technically curious and ready to build your career in technical sales — we want to hear from you.
